forum.content_text:
Hello everyone,

I would like to share my recent project developed using **TouchGFX** for industrial applications.

I have designed a fully **modular keyboard UI using custom containers**. The keyboard supports:

* **Uppercase and lowercase input**

* **Numeric keypad**

* **Special characters**

* **Password input**

* **Email input**

* **Calibration data entry**

The project is designed with a focus on **real-time usability** and **clean UI design for embedded systems**.

**GitHub Repository:**

[https://github.com/DhruvProject4/touchgfx\_advanced\_keyboard.git](https://github.com/DhruvProject4/touchgfx_advanced_keyboard.git "GitHub Repository")

**Screenshots:**

![Screenshot 2026-03-23 194607.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/92b15efe-9272-fc48-2901-17d3d78aac45.png "Screenshot 2026-03-23 194607.png")

![Screenshot 2026-03-23 194639.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/9706046f-10b6-f024-4f8d-caef15b5cde1.png "Screenshot 2026-03-23 194639.png")

![Screenshot 2026-03-23 201138.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/0336d49f-fb4e-a39a-9768-4cffcd75da59.png "Screenshot 2026-03-23 201138.png")

I would really appreciate your **feedback and suggestions**.

Thank you

**Dhruv Dave**
